<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will count how many distinct carbon signals fall within the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (approximately 110–160 ppm). This will give the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
